verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform like Salv, so the axis applies. The evidence covers importing data (CSV upload, addPerson and addTransaction endpoints) and a few narrow read endpoints such as fetching person risk factors. Nothing documents a full export of customer data in open formats or a path for leaving the platform.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
